location.en: Your studio, on the phone with Maple Bay Power
location.zh: 你的套房，和楓灣電力公司通電話

goal.en: Point out a billing mistake and ask the company to fix it.
goal.zh: 指出帳單上的錯誤，請電力公司處理。

background: small studio apartment kitchen table in the evening, an open envelope, a blank sheet of paper, a calculator and a mug of tea, warm desk lamp light

intro.en: Your first electricity bill arrives. The total is almost twice what you expected.
intro.zh: 你的第一張電費帳單寄來了。金額幾乎是你預期的兩倍。

intro.en: Looking closer, you see the same month listed twice. You call Maple Bay Power.
intro.zh: 仔細一看，同一個月份被列了兩次。你打電話給楓灣電力公司。

lines.en: Maple Bay Power, billing department. This is Marcus. How can I help?
lines.zh: 楓灣電力帳務部，我是馬可斯。有什麼可以幫您的？

choices.en: Hi. I think there's a mistake on my bill this month.
choices.zh: 嗨。我覺得我這個月的帳單有錯。
choices.tip: I think there's a mistake on my bill. 用 I think 開頭，客觀說明問題，不是一開始就指責對方。

choices.en: Your company made a big mistake. You're stealing my money!
choices.zh: 你們公司搞錯了。你們在偷我的錢！

lines.en: Whoa. Let's not jump to conclusions. Let me read you our billing policy first.
lines.zh: 哇。先別急著下結論。我先為您說明我們的計費規定。

story.en: Marcus reads the company's billing policy to you, word by word. Fifteen minutes pass before he even looks at your bill.
story.zh: 馬可斯一字一句地唸計費規定給你聽。過了十五分鐘，他才開始看你的帳單。

fail.why: 一開口就指控對方偷錢，客服只會進入防衛模式。先客觀說明：I think there's a mistake on my bill.

choices.en: My bill is wrong number. The money is too much this time.
choices.zh: 我的帳單數字錯了。這次的錢太多了。

lines.en: Wrong number? Oh, did you mean to call someone else? Let me transfer you.
lines.zh: 打錯電話？喔，您是要打給別人嗎？我幫您轉接。

story.en: Marcus politely transfers you to the phone company. You end up explaining your electricity bill to a very confused stranger.
story.zh: 馬可斯很有禮貌地把你轉到電信公司。你最後對著一個一頭霧水的陌生人解釋電費帳單。

fail.why: wrong number 在電話裡是「打錯電話」。帳單金額有錯要說 There's a mistake on my bill. 或 The amount is wrong.

lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your account.
lines.zh: 很抱歉。我來調出您的帳戶資料。

lines.en: You hear typing on the other end of the line.
lines.zh: 你聽到電話那頭傳來打字聲。

lines.en: Okay, I have it here. What looks wrong to you?
lines.zh: 好，我看到了。您覺得哪裡有問題？

choices.en: It looks like I was charged twice for the same month.
choices.zh: 看起來同一個月份被收了兩次錢。
choices.tip: I was charged twice. 用被動語態說「被收費」，一聽就知道是重複扣款。

choices.en: I think I charged two times for the same month of electricity.
choices.zh: 我覺得同一個月的電費收了我兩次。

lines.en: You charged...? Did you make the same payment twice?
lines.zh: 您收了……？您是重複付款了嗎？

story.en: Marcus searches for a double payment from you. There isn't one, so he decides your account is fine.
story.zh: 馬可斯開始找你的重複付款紀錄。結果找不到，他就判定你的帳戶沒問題。

fail.why: 「被收費」要用被動語態：I was charged twice. 說 I charged，意思變成是你收了費或你付了兩次。

choices.en: The problem is I'm a student and I don't have much money.
choices.zh: 問題是我是學生，我沒什麼錢。

lines.en: Oh, I see. Would you like to set up a payment plan, then?
lines.zh: 喔，我了解了。那您想辦分期付款嗎？

story.en: Marcus kindly lets you pay the wrong bill in six easy installments. The mistake is still there.
story.zh: 馬可斯很貼心地讓你把錯誤的帳單分六期付清。但錯誤還是在那裡。

fail.why: 對方問的是帳單哪裡有問題，不是你的經濟狀況。直接指出錯誤：I was charged twice for the same month.

lines.en: Hmm, you're right. I see two charges for last month.
lines.zh: 嗯，您說得對。我看到上個月有兩筆費用。

lines.en: That's strange. It might take a few days to sort out.
lines.zh: 這很奇怪。可能要幾天時間才能處理好。

choices.en: Could you look into it and let me know what you find?
choices.zh: 可以請你調查一下，再告訴我結果嗎？
choices.tip: Could you look into it? 請對方深入調查，再加上 let me know 請對方回報結果。

choices.en: Can you help me check it? I will wait for your news.
choices.zh: 可以幫我查一下嗎？我等你的消息。

lines.en: Check it? I just did. It's two charges. And... my news?
lines.zh: 查一下？我剛查過了，是兩筆。還有……我的新聞？

story.en: Marcus checks again, confirms there are two charges, and waits. Nobody opens an investigation, and the bill stays the same.
story.zh: 馬可斯又查了一次，確認有兩筆，然後就等你下一步。沒人提出調查，帳單金額照舊。

fail.why: 「幫我查一下」直譯成 help me check，對方可能看一眼就結束。要對方調查處理說 Could you look into it?「等你消息」說 Please let me know what you find.

choices.en: Never mind. It's too troublesome. I'll just pay it all.
choices.zh: 算了。太麻煩了。我全部付掉就好。

lines.en: Are you sure? You'd be paying for the same month twice.
lines.zh: 您確定嗎？這樣同一個月您會付兩次喔。

story.en: You pay the whole bill to avoid the hassle. That's forty dollars of smoothie money, gone.
story.zh: 為了省麻煩，你把整張帳單都付了。四十元的果昔基金就這樣沒了。

fail.why: 遇到小麻煩就想「算了，多一事不如少一事」，結果是白白多付錢。在這裡，多收的費用只要提出就能退。請對方處理：Could you look into it?

lines.en: Of course. I've opened a review. You should hear back within five business days.
lines.zh: 當然。我已經提出審查了，您會在五個工作天內收到回覆。

lines.en: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
lines.zh: 今天還有其他需要幫忙的地方嗎？

choices.en: No, that's everything. Thank you for looking into this.
choices.zh: 沒有了，就這些。謝謝你幫忙處理。
choices.tip: Thank you for looking into this. 謝謝對方願意處理，讓通話有個好結尾，之後追蹤也更順利。

choices.en: No. If I don't hear back, I will calling again next week.
choices.zh: 沒有。如果沒收到回覆，我下禮拜會再打來。

lines.en: You're calling again? But... we're still on the phone. Hello?
lines.zh: 您又打來了？可是……我們還在通話中啊。喂？

story.en: Marcus thinks the line is bad and asks you to repeat everything. The call ends ten minutes later than it should.
story.zh: 馬可斯以為收訊不好，請你把剛剛的話全部再說一次。這通電話多講了十分鐘。

fail.why: will 後面接原形動詞：I'll call again next week. will calling 不是正確句型，對方會聽成你「現在又打來」。

choices.en: Just make sure it's fixed, or I'm switching companies.
choices.zh: 你最好把它修好，不然我就換公司。

lines.en: Well, we're the only power company in Maple Bay. But... noted.
lines.zh: 這個嘛，我們是楓灣唯一的電力公司。不過……我記下了。

story.en: Your threat has nowhere to go. Marcus ends the call politely, and you feel a little silly.
story.zh: 你的威脅無處可去。馬可斯禮貌地結束通話，你覺得自己有點糗。

fail.why: 對方已經答應處理，你還補一句威脅，聽起來很不信任人。好好道謝就好：Thank you for looking into this.

lines.en: My pleasure. Have a good evening!
lines.zh: 不客氣。祝您有個愉快的晚上！

lines.en: Three days later, an email arrives. The extra charge has been removed.
lines.zh: 三天後，你收到一封電子郵件。多收的費用已經取消了。

story.en: Your next bill is forty dollars lower. Heater, doctor, wallet, power bill: you're getting pretty good at this living-alone thing.
story.zh: 下一期帳單少了四十元。暖氣、看病、錢包、電費，你越來越懂得怎麼獨立生活了。

notes.en: I think there's a mistake on my bill.
notes.explain: 用 I think 開頭比較客觀，不會一開始就變成指責。帳單上的錯誤用介系詞 on：a mistake on my bill。

example.en: I think there's a mistake on my phone bill.
example.zh: 我覺得我的電話帳單有錯。

notes.explain: 「被收費」用被動語態 be charged。twice 比 two times 自然；三次以上才說 three times。

example.en: I was charged for something I didn't buy.
example.zh: 我被收了一筆我沒買的東西的錢。

notes.explain: look into 是「調查、深入了解」。請客服處理問題時，比 help me check 更清楚表示要對方追查到底。

example.en: Could you look into why my package is late?
example.zh: 可以幫我查一下包裹為什麼延遲嗎？

notes.explain: 在電話裡 You have the wrong number. 是「你打錯了」。金額有誤要說 The amount is wrong. 或 There's a mistake on my bill.

example.en: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
example.zh: 抱歉，你好像打錯電話了。

notes.explain: 怕麻煩就算了，等於白白多付錢。在楓灣，打給客服說明清楚，公司通常會調查並退回多收的費用，這是消費者的基本權利。

example.en: I'd like to dispute this charge.
example.zh: 我想對這筆費用提出異議。
